promptingStudio.scene: A clean domestic home-studio with reflection filters. Tight acoustical isolation, vocal forward in the mix with zero noticeable room slap.
promptingStudio.sampleContext: Casual, witty, slightly sarcastic and rapid-fire. Expressive inflection with comedic pauses and self-aware irony.
promptingStudio.sampleSpeechBlock: No gods, no souls, no rot. And then it broke. Not shattered by some grand battle or divine betrayal. It just split on its own. The first and greatest fracture in all of reality. From that split came the outer gods. And like any dysfunctional family tree, each fragment immediately developed its own personality crisis. The greater will wanted control, order, law, and golden light at the expense of everything else. The frenzied flame wanted freedom by incinerating identity, memory, and probably your pets. The formless mother craved connection through blood, obsession, and deeply concerning boundaries. The scarlet rot whispered promises of beauty, growth, and decay. In the same breath, the dark moon just watched cold, distant, calculating.

Speaker 1 - Lore Comedian (Antoni / Liam):
No gods, no souls, no rot. And then it broke. Not shattered by some grand battle or divine betrayal. It just split on its own. The first and greatest fracture in all of reality. From that split came the outer gods. And like any dysfunctional family tree, each fragment immediately developed its own personality crisis. The greater will wanted control, order, law, and golden light at the expense of everything else. The frenzied flame wanted freedom by incinerating identity, memory, and probably your pets. The formless mother craved connection through blood, obsession, and deeply concerning boundaries. The scarlet rot whispered promises of beauty, growth, and decay. In the same breath, the dark moon just watched cold, distant, calculating.
